title: Case 035: Request to Review a Fee
initial_request: Mara wants H&V to review whether a £4.50 paper statement fee, dated 18 June 2025, was correctly applied. She says she had chosen electronic statements and disputes the fee.
overview: H&V notified Mara of the paper statement fee through its secure portal. After completing identification checks on a call, she asked for the tariff application to be reviewed. The agent registered the specific transaction and her reason with the Tariff Team; the team confirmed that the request was accepted for review.

next_action.summary: Register the request with the Tariff Team, identifying the £4.50 fee dated 18 June 2025 and Mara’s reason for disputing its application.

outcome: The Tariff Team confirmed that the request was accepted for review. No fee cancellation or refund was confirmed.

events.body: A £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025 has been applied to your account. This notification does not confirm whether the fee will be changed.
After completing H&V’s identification checks, I asked you to review the £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025. I had chosen electronic statements, so I dispute how the tariff was applied.

I have registered Mara Ellison’s request for review of the £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025. Her reason is that she had chosen electronic statements; her inline request reads, “please check how the tariff was applied.”
Request HV-035 registered and routed to the Tariff Team. Registration does not indicate a decision on the fee.

We have accepted your request for review of the tariff application for the paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025. This confirms acceptance for review only; no cancellation or refund has been confirmed.
